findings.title: The fix replaces a per-invocation path with a single fixed, shared scratch file _working/idea-planner/draft-path.txt with no track-id or dispatch-unique component, so two concurrent planner dispatches in one worktree can overwrite each other's path before the check reads it.
findings.evidence: .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:150-153 / agent-workflows/idea-planner-agent.md:150-153. The planner is invoked once per accepted track; nothing in the fix or GOV-014 restricts an orchestrator to one planner dispatch at a time in a worktree. Every test uses an isolated tmp_path; none exercises concurrent writers.
findings.consequence: A track's conformance check silently validates against the wrong track's draft, or a path no longer matching what that dispatch wrote. A regression introduced by this fix, untested.

findings.title: Write is granted with no path-scoping at the tool-permission level; the restriction to the draft and the path file is prose-only.
findings.evidence: .claude/settings.json has only unrelated deny rules; no Write(docs/00-working/promoted/**)-style allow-list exists in .claude/agents/*.md. Matches every other Write-capable agent (demo-creator-*, demo-orch-*).
findings.consequence: A confused or adversarially-prompted planner dispatch could Write anywhere Write is otherwise permitted, including over docs/01-plans/ or source files. Not a new gap; consistent with the owner's instruction-level ruling.
